title: Free-roaming animal population observability
summary: Population estimates require abundance, turnover, ownership, movement and welfare observations; visibility and identity assumptions complicate estimation.

title: Population replenishment and reproductive control
summary: Sterilization outcomes depend on births, immigration, abandonment, roaming, coverage and continuity, not procedure counts alone.

title: Rabies vaccination and One Health integration
summary: Vaccination, post-exposure prophylaxis, surveillance and community engagement are distinct from population control.

title: Responsible ownership, abandonment and relinquishment
summary: Roaming, loss, abandonment and uncontrolled reproduction link owned animals to free-roaming populations.

title: Equitable primary-care access and capacity
summary: Geographic, workforce, financial and organizational barriers affect access and continuity; PEP is specialist preventive access, not interchangeable with all primary-care services.
